title: 28 · thousand_lotus · The Thousandth Lotus
lines: Vishnu once offered Shiva his own eye.
Because he was one flower short.
And Vishnu knew where strength comes from.
He vowed to worship Shiva with a thousand lotuses.
Shiva had hidden the last flower.
Vishnu did not get up to look for another.
They call me the lotus-eyed, he said.
"They call me the lotus-eyed," he said.
Then let my eye be the lotus.
"Then let my eye be the lotus."
And placed in that hand a wheel of light.
The weapon Vishnu carries in every picture
was a gift for one missing flower.
Give the thing you are known for. That is sadhana.
